en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural valley with dense conifer forest on the surrounding hillsides. In the foreground stands a large half‑timbered farmhouse with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, accompanied by a wooden barn across a narrow country road. Trees and meadows fill the scene, and framing branches overhang the top of the image. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
